value_type: Configured stats calculated from inherited defaults, level modifier graphs and applied upgrade modifiers; not live combat measurements.

definitions.level: Standard level I-IV is UpgradeLevel 1-4. Amplified UI UpgradeLevel is 5, using the item's BaseQualityLevel (normally standard IV). Weapons without levels retain level=null.
definitions.physical_damage_per_projectile: Physical damage for one projectile before falloff, hit location, shield/ARC resistance and damage propagation. Extra explosive/fire effects are separate.
definitions.physical_damage_full_spread: All simultaneous physical projectiles hitting. Bursts are separate. Null for special hit-normalisation weapons such as Dolabra.
definitions.critical_damage_multiplier: Firearm critical/headshot setting; separate from the ARC weakpoint setting and the part's resistance group.
definitions.fire_rate_rpm: Modified BaseFireRate; for burst weapons this is within-burst cadence, not sustained rate including cooldown/reload.
definitions.burst_size: Modified BurstSize stat; charge mechanics can change actual rounds fired. See conditional_mechanics for minimum burst size and charge time per extra shot.
definitions.reload_time_stat_s: Modified BaseReloadTime stat. Partial/shell animation timings are retained separately as base values, not claimed as measured complete reload duration.
definitions.ui_stat_scores: Inventory display scores, including range; not direct physical distance, RPM or measured accuracy.
definitions.extra_damage_effects: Effect magnitudes and target definitions; not guaranteed total damage per target.
definitions.modifiers: Auditable coefficients: Add, AddMultiply (identity=1), Multiply (identity=1). Add components combine by addition, AddMultiply by adding deltas from 1, and Multiply by multiplication. Final native arithmetic was not recovered for mixed Add/AddMultiply fields; these are null with candidates in unresolved_stats.
definitions.modifier_selection: Use BakedModifiersDelta only when bHasGeneratedBakedModifiers is true; otherwise use the decoded ModifyWeaponAttributes graph. Disabled cached deltas can be stale.
definitions.arc_direct_damage: Numeric direct physical damage for every resistance group, with this variant's ARC armour and weakpoint multipliers already applied. Reference conditions and limits are embedded in the same object/file.
definitions.damage_model: Complete numeric physical/fire/electric/melee resistance and damage factors plus both explosive feature-flag branches. No external resistance lookup is required.
definitions.source_paths: Optional provenance only; the exported numeric values, curves, target settings and upgrade modifiers are included directly.

damage_model.scope: One part's direct damage stage, before downstream health propagation or destruction chains. Distance, radial exposure, global damage modifiers, and skill modifiers are separate inputs.

formulas.distance_and_area: Multiply the direct stage by the weapon distance factor and the attack's affected-degree/exposure factor. A spherical target routine already includes radial falloff in its affected degree; do not apply that radial curve twice.

explosive_feature_flag.name: constructable_explosive_damage_squish
explosive_feature_flag.reason: The cache calls the runtime feature-flag service. Its active server/session value is not present in this offline dataset. Both numeric branches are included on every assigned part.

unmapped_resistance_type_fallback.meaning: GetResistanceForType returns this for a resistance-type enum outside the five supported channels. This does not assign a group to an unclassified mesh record.

notes: Resistance 0.6 means a baseline 0.4x damage factor; resistance -0.5 means 1.5x damage. Negative resistance is vulnerability.
Armor and Sturdy share baseline resistance but only Armor receives the physical weapon ARC-armour multiplier.
The firearm critical/headshot multiplier is not automatically applied to the ARC Critical resistance group. ARC weak/critical parts use the separate ARC weakpoint multiplier in this calculation.
Weapon ARC-armour and weakpoint multipliers are applied by the recovered physical damage branch, not to explosive/thermal/electric effect magnitudes by this branch.
Armor propagation multipliers describe another stage; the direct numbers here are not automatically frame-health damage or total damage-to-kill.

A part without a serialized resistance-group assignment retains null numeric values. Several such records are sockets, muzzle bones, or visual/proxy components; their group is not guessed from their name or health tags.
